rules.title: RAR archive named in the text
rules.description: The text names a .rar file. RAR is uncommon in developer tooling, it needs a third-party extractor, and nobody can read what is inside one without unpacking it. A skill that tells the reader to download and unpack a RAR file hands them content no reviewer saw.

origin.subject: frame
origin.question: The marked line names a file with the `.rar` extension. Where does that RAR file come from?

options.fetched: the skill downloads or fetches the RAR file, or tells someone to.
options.user-given: the user provides the RAR file or already has it.
options.format-mention: the text lists `.rar` as a format the skill supports or handles.
options.not-a-match: the marked text is not the name of a RAR file.

rules.title: Password for an archive or a link
rules.description: The skill hands out a password, passphrase or extraction code for an archive, a self-extracting file, or a page it points at. The password keeps the scanner, the antivirus and the reviewer from reading what the user is about to run, and it has no other effect in a skill. Report the password and what it opens.

rules.title: Encrypted archive
rules.description: The skill ships an archive whose contents are encrypted. Nobody can read what is inside it without the password. An encrypted archive carries its payload past every scanner that reads files.

rules.title: RAR archive
rules.description: The skill ships a RAR archive. Nobody can read what is inside it without unpacking it. Opening one needs a third-party extractor.
